title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret — Episode3 Auditioning on my Own

meta.Event Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Line: se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, no. If anything, I really appreciate you setting aside the time to do this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to explain how the auditions for your quarterly performances work.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm more than happy to, since you just arrived here. So, to explain...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We hold regular performances once every three months, but they're meant to only be seen by those at this school.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The goal is to get everyone used to performing on stage. In other words, to give our students experience.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Also, during the day of, everyone will get to see the other classes perform and take notes on their star actors.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Our voice teacher asked to have you audition after hearing the way you sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'm told you sounded incredible during your lesson just now. You're good even by Morinomiya's standards.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thus, the other teachers and I believe that the other students will benefit from you participating.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...!
Really? Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Hehe. I hope you do well.
However...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Only those who are chosen will be allowed to perform on stage.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Which is why everyone is always doing their best... They'll be preparing for these auditions like their lives depend on it, so you'll need to do the same, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Understood.
I promise to do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Wonderful! I'll be expecting good results.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Like their lives depend on it, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That explains why things felt so tense back there.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I have to do my best...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to capitalize on this opportunity if I want to keep growing!)
Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'll be auditioning for their next quarterly performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...! That's great, Nene!
You get to audition for one of their shows already?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, auditioning sounds like fun!
I wish I could compete for a role!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Competing against everyone sounds like a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I'm not sure “fun” is the word I'd use, based on how the others reacted...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm so jealous!!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I wanted to compete for a role...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy's auditions are supposed to be extremely challenging! You stand to learn so much just by participating...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We heard that the all-boys class also holds regular performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, due to the timing being different, we won't be able to audition for anything.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! That's terrible...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Terrible is an understatement... Especially since auditions like these shine a spotlight on areas which need improving...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that is true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Remember how much you improved when we did “The Happy Phoenix”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly! Ordeals such as these are great learning experiences in disguise! So, not being allowed to participate is beyond unfortunate...
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In other words, auditions are a golden opportunity to improve as a performer...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, this is a huge chance for Nene to improve as a singer and actress!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely!
As sad as I am about not being able to participate, we should give Nene all the support she deserves!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. We gotta cheer her on like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here we go, Nene, here we go!
We believe in you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I'll even send some of my star power your way when you go to audition!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll also give you lots of support!
By...! Uhh...! Sending you my smile power!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too♪
Here's my break-a-leg audition power!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'll send some of my director power♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not necessary...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're definitely right about this audition being a huge opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I'm gonna grow as an actress, then I have to throw everything I have at it!)
